rules.name: Convert SAM anonymous inner classes to lambda expressions
rules.description: Java 8 introduced lambda expressions which can replace many anonymous inner class declarations that implement a Single Abstract Method (SAM) interface. This reduces boilerplate code (e.g., Runnable, Callable, ActionListener, Comparator). JADE contains many anonymous inner classes for agent behaviours and event handlers that are prime candidates.

patterns.reason: Convert anonymous inner classes implementing SAM interfaces (Runnable, Callable, ActionListener, etc.) to Java 8 lambda expressions.

rules.verification_hint: Compile with Java 8 javac and verify anonymous class-to-lambda conversions compile without errors. Runtime behavior must be equivalent.

rules.name: Collection.removeAll() and retainAll() now throw NPE for null argument
rules.description: In Java 7, some collection implementations would silently ignore a null parameter to removeAll() or retainAll() if the collection was empty. Java 8 consistently throws NullPointerException for null parameters regardless of collection state.

patterns.reason: Ensure null is not passed to Collection.removeAll() or retainAll() to avoid NullPointerException on Java 8.

rules.verification_hint: Search for removeAll(null) and retainAll(null) calls in the codebase; add null guards before these calls or replace with empty collection.

rules.name: PermGen JVM flags (-XX:PermSize, -XX:MaxPermSize) removed in Java 8
rules.description: Java 8 removed the Permanent Generation (PermGen) from the HotSpot JVM (JEP 122). The command-line flags -XX:PermSize and -XX:MaxPermSize are now ignored and produce warnings. Class metadata is now stored in native memory (Metaspace). Any JADE startup scripts or Ant build files referencing these flags must be updated.

patterns.reason: Remove obsolete PermGen JVM flags from scripts and configuration files; replace with -XX:MetaspaceSize and -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize if memory tuning is needed.

rules.verification_hint: Check that no startup scripts or Ant build files contain -XX:PermSize or -XX:MaxPermSize flags.

rules.name: Thread.stop(Throwable) disabled in Java 8
rules.description: The Thread.stop(Throwable) method, deprecated since Java 1.2, now throws UnsupportedOperationException in Java 8. Any code calling this deprecated method must be refactored to use safer alternatives like Thread.interrupt() or cooperative shutdown with volatile boolean flags.

patterns.reason: Replace deprecated Thread.stop(Throwable) calls with safer alternatives like Thread.interrupt() or cooperative shutdown mechanisms using volatile boolean flags.
Broad scan for any .stop() calls that may invoke the now-disabled Thread.stop() or related deprecated thread termination methods.

rules.verification_hint: Search for Thread.stop() and .stop(Throwable) usage; if found, replace with interrupt() or cooperative shutdown mechanisms.
